test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If a = 10 and b = 3, then what is the value of ((a+b)²)/(a²-b²)?
solution:
**Given:**

a = 10 and b = 3

**Calculation:**

⇒ **((a+b)²)/(a²-b²)**

⇒ **((a+b)²)/((a-b)(a+b))**

⇒ **((a+b))/((a-b))**

Put the values of a and b

⇒ ((10+3))/((10-3))

⇒ 13/7 = 169/91

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
